lines.label: A
lines.text: If you are a minister, member of a religious order, or Christian Science practitioner and you filed Form 4361, but you had $400 or more of other net earnings from self-employment, check here and continue with Part I

lines.label: 1a
lines.text: Net farm profit or (loss) from Schedule F, line 34, and farm partnerships, Schedule K-1 (Form 1065), box 14, code A.

lines.label: b
lines.text: If you received social security retirement or disability benefits, enter the amount of Conservation Reserve Program payments included on Schedule F, line 4b, or listed on Schedule K-1 (Form 1065), box 20, code AQ

Net profit or (loss) from Schedule C, line 31; and Schedule K-1 (Form 1065), box 14, code A (other than farming). See instructions for other income to report or if you are a minister or member of a religious order.
Combine lines 1a, 1b, and 2

lines.label: 4a
lines.text: If line 3 is more than zero, multiply line 3 by 92.35% (0.9235). Otherwise, enter amount from line 3

lines.label: b
lines.text: If you elect one or both of the optional methods, enter the total of lines 15 and 17 here

lines.label: c
lines.text: Combine lines 4a and 4b. If less than $400, stop; you don't owe self-employment tax. Exception: If less than $400 and you had church employee income, enter -0- and continue

lines.label: 5a
lines.text: Enter your church employee income from Form W-2. See instructions for definition of church employee income

lines.label: b
lines.text: Multiply line 5a by 92.35% (0.9235). If less than $100, enter -0-
Add lines 4c and 5b
Maximum amount of combined wages and self-employment earnings subject to social security tax or the 6.2% portion of the 7.65% railroad retirement (tier 1) tax for 2023

lines.label: 8a
lines.text: Total social security wages and tips (total of boxes 3 and 7 on Form(s) W-2) and railroad retirement (tier 1) compensation. If $160,200 or more, skip lines 8b through 10, and go to line 11

lines.label: b
lines.text: Unreported tips subject to social security tax from Form 4137, line 10

lines.label: c
lines.text: Wages subject to social security tax from Form 8919, line 10

lines.label: d
lines.text: Add lines 8a, 8b, and 8c
Subtract line 8d from line 7. If zero or less, enter -0- here and on line 10 and go to line 11
Multiply the smaller of line 6 or line 9 by 12.4% (0.124)
Multiply line 6 by 2.9% (0.029)
Self-employment tax. Add lines 10 and 11. Enter here and on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 4.
Deduction for one-half of self-employment tax.
Maximum income for optional methods.
Enter the smaller of: two-thirds ( 2 / 3 ) of gross farm income 1 (not less than zero) or $6,560. Also include this amount on line 4b above

Enter the smaller of: two-thirds ( 2 / 3 ) of gross nonfarm income 4 (not less than zero) or the amount on line 16. Also include this amount on line 4b above
